stories.title: Emergency doctor ‘completely terrified’ of looming winter pressures on NHS
stories.summary: BBC Scotland reports that Dr Fiona Hunter described unsafe A&E conditions and patients spending up to 72 hours on corridor trolleys; the Scottish health secretary also responded. The BBC page displayed ‘16 hours ago’ at the scheduled-run check, which places it inside the specified 48-hour window, but the page text did not expose an exact publication minute; the displayed relative age implied approximately 11 October 2026 13:00 UTC.
